purpose: Machine-readable Phase-3 admission record for post-v1 premises. This records why P201-P206 earned IDs without mutating the frozen v1 mining input.

admissions.proposition: Apparent support volume must be reduced to independent causal ancestry or the appropriate clustered independent unit before it can increase confidence in a premise.
admissions.architectureEpoch: epoch-independent research-inference rule; concrete independent unit remains study-dependent
admissions.maturityStage: admitted semantic premise; no runtime treatment
admissions.increaseConfidenceObservation: independently selected evidence lineages reproduce the claim after causal ancestry is collapsed rather than merely multiplying descendant reports/rows
admissions.decreaseConfidenceObservation: a v1 premise is shown to entail causal-ancestry support accounting cleanly without broad reinterpretation
admissions.splitPropositionObservation: different study types require different clustered units, while the parent ancestry rule remains stable
contradictionsOrTensions: raw appearance count can exceed independent support count
admissions.intendedInformationLifetime: research-program lifetime subject to explicit lineage updates
admissions.intendedTransferRadius: across solver research studies, not across unrelated causal units by assumption
admissions.identityFreeGeneralizationUnit: causally independent lineage or justified clustered unit
admissions.notes: Phase 2 S2-C04 independently rediscovered the decision-bearing nature of the independent unit.

admissions.proposition: Evidence status is path-dependent and consumable: once an evaluation block or population outcome influences descendant design, it becomes development evidence for those descendants even if it was originally untouched confirmation evidence.
admissions.architectureEpoch: research-method rule; concrete evidence pools are epoch-specific
admissions.maturityStage: admitted semantic premise; already reflected in evaluation discipline
admissions.increaseConfidenceObservation: descendant-design decisions demonstrably condition on previously untouched block outcomes and the repository correctly reclassifies those outcomes as development evidence
admissions.decreaseConfidenceObservation: a representation of evidence role is found that remains valid after adaptive use without recording the use transition
admissions.splitPropositionObservation: different descendants consume different evidence blocks or summaries
admissions.intendedInformationLifetime: until descendant ancestry is retired or evidence role is explicitly reset by a genuinely independent source
admissions.intendedTransferRadius: descendants whose design was influenced by the evidence
admissions.notes: Distinct from ordinary architecture freshness in P005 and maturity gates in P198.

admissions.proposition: As a research result propagates through reports, capability memory, question state, future-work prose, or execution priority, downstream claims must preserve its scope, conditioning, information authority, causal ancestry, and maturity rather than silently broadening them.
admissions.architectureEpoch: cross-epoch governance rule; individual claims retain their own epoch qualifiers
admissions.maturityStage: admitted semantic premise; governance use only
admissions.increaseConfidenceObservation: source-to-consumer traces show that preserving explicit qualifiers prevents a materially broader downstream interpretation
admissions.decreaseConfidenceObservation: all decision-bearing consumers are proven to derive scope/authority/maturity mechanically from the primary evidence without drift
admissions.splitPropositionObservation: different propagation channels exhibit different failure modes while sharing the qualifier-preservation parent
temporalDependencies: architecture epoch carried by source claim
relations: EPISTEMIC_PREREQUISITE_FOR downstream closure and priority claims
contradictionsOrTensions: local validity can coexist with downstream overstatement
admissions.intendedTransferRadius: every downstream consumer of that claim
admissions.notes: This is the admitted semantic core of S2-C01; S2-C01 receives no duplicate ID.

admissions.proposition: An observation supports a causal research conclusion only to the extent that the observation could discriminate that conclusion from materially different rival explanations.
admissions.architectureEpoch: portable inference rule; rival set and discriminating observations are epoch-conditioned
admissions.increaseConfidenceObservation: a planned observation differs under material rival explanations and the observed outcome excludes at least one rival at its stated scope
admissions.decreaseConfidenceObservation: purported causal evidence remains identical under the material rival explanations
admissions.splitPropositionObservation: different causal claims require different counterfactuals, while the discriminability rule remains common
contradictionsOrTensions: correlation can be real while causal interpretation remains underdetermined
admissions.intendedInformationLifetime: until a material rival or conditioning change invalidates the discrimination
admissions.intendedTransferRadius: claims sharing the same causal contrast and conditions
admissions.notes: Generalizes several specific v1 rival distinctions without replacing them.

admissions.proposition: Premise-map completeness confidence requires reciprocal source coverage and independent-pass saturation evidence; proposition provenance and internal graph coverage are necessary but cannot establish that premise-bearing source regions were sampled.
admissions.maturityStage: admitted after first frozen v1 mining round; methodological only
admissions.increaseConfidenceObservation: heterogeneous independently selected source batches reach saturation after all major strata have explicit dispositions
admissions.decreaseConfidenceObservation: an unsampled major source stratum yields a high-impact new parent premise or repeated ontology escape
admissions.splitPropositionObservation: source-surface coverage and semantic saturation can move independently and should remain separate dimensions
contradictionsOrTensions: complete proposition provenance can coexist with incomplete source sampling
admissions.identityFreeGeneralizationUnit: repository source stratum / independent discovery pass
admissions.notes: H16 intentionally prohibited admission into v1 before the first mining round; Phase 3 is the first eligible boundary.

admissions.proposition: Decision-bearing sample size is the opportunity population in which the treatment can causally change the tested outcome, not raw row count or feature eligibility alone.
admissions.architectureEpoch: experiment and treatment epoch-specific; sizing rule portable
admissions.maturityStage: admitted semantic premise; no treatment implied
admissions.increaseConfidenceObservation: opportunity-sized experiments achieve the prespecified number of rows where control fails and treatment can actually participate/change outcome
admissions.decreaseConfidenceObservation: raw eligible N predicts decision power equally after causal opportunity is controlled
admissions.splitPropositionObservation: different treatments define different opportunity intersections even on the same nominal population
relations: EPISTEMIC_PREREQUISITE_FOR matched-work null and detectability claims
contradictionsOrTensions: large nominal N can coexist with negligible causal headroom
admissions.intendedTransferRadius: experiments with the same causal opportunity definition
admissions.identityFreeGeneralizationUnit: causal opportunity row / justified clustered opportunity unit
admissions.notes: Distinct from generic benchmark representativeness and nominal treatment participation.

nonAdmissions.disposition: scope relation only; no premise id
nonAdmissions.reason: Its valid independence-axis distinctions are better preserved across P201, P199, P158, P190 and P191 than re-conflated into a new umbrella node.
Semantic novelty is plausible, but recurring harmful transformation first-divergence evidence beyond ordinary ordering/retention has not been shown.

Phase-3 semantic reconciliation maps them to P136/P142/P148/P175/P181-P200 and/or the admitted P201/P203/P206, or classifies them as relation/interface/experimental primitives. See the reconciliation report for row-level dispositions.
